title: Layered panels
sampleTitle: Build systems your team can trust
description: The same overlapping panels, with a quieter surface and cleaner separation between the layers.
changes: Cleaner blue layers with a faint edge highlight.
patternRule: Three empty rounded surfaces with the same 90px corner radius and stepped overlaps. Keep the structure abstract, with no interface controls.
gradientRule: A pale flat field surrounds translucent-looking blue layers. Each layer carries its own restrained directional light.

title: Soft imprint
sampleTitle: Give your team a clear starting point
description: The same soft symbol impression, with more controlled diffusion and extra room around the headline.
changes: A clearer upper edge fades into softer light.
Moved the headline left and slightly upward.
Kept the blue field and typography unchanged.
patternRule: Use the exact mark as one enlarged, softly cropped impression. Keep a minimum128px text inset and adjust the title block before reducing its size.
gradientRule: The upper edge has more definition while the lower impression diffuses into blue. The title area remains flat.
